focus: P3 negative controls, prefix/intermediate assertions, timing permutations, refusal non-mutation, and cross-adapter authorized trace parity
noveltyJustification: Iteration 004 established semantic fixture coverage and external intermediate oracles; this pass adds a concrete mutant matrix, separates transport-time invariance from semantic deadline permutations, resolves refusal non-mutation across domain and audit ledgers, defines the cross-adapter semantic field allowlist, and rejects whole-descriptor equality across isolated runs.
keyFindings: Parity is a prefix-indexed operation, authorization, outcome, event-range, and projection-checkpoint transcript rather than one terminal trace
Every positive parity case needs manifest-bound single-defect mutants that fail with the intended class and earliest mismatch
Timing parity separates ignorable transport jitter from semantic deadline and observed-time boundary permutations
Refusal non-mutation means unchanged domain, projection, budget, and effects plus exactly one linked authorization-audit denial
Cross-adapter normalization is an explicit allowlist that preserves authorization, causality, effect, budget, refusal, and checkpoint semantics
Isolated adapter runs verify separate run-specific descriptors and compare registered semantic components rather than whole descriptor digests

ruledOut.approach: Use final snapshot plus deterministic rerun as sufficient parity
ruledOut.reason: Stable reruns can reproduce a shared reducer defect or the same omitted prefix observation
Record transport time may be informational, but deadlines and observed time are semantic inputs

ruledOut.approach: Require no append anywhere on denial
ruledOut.reason: Domain state must not change, while 036 requires one immutable non-domain authorization decision

ruledOut.approach: Compare whole replay descriptor digests across isolated adapters
ruledOut.reason: Run and ledger identity legitimately differ; each descriptor verifies independently before semantic component comparison

ruledOut.approach: Represent denial as a domain event
ruledOut.reason: The authorization-audit decision supplies visibility without contaminating domain history
